---
description: Preserve source units, fiscal periods, and purchasing-power bases when changing financial ETL calculations.
applyTo: 'models/**,services/**,read_statements/**,tests/**'
---

Retain reported quarterly and YTD observations independently; an interim YTD value must not be discarded merely because the source also reports a quarter. Derive flows across filings only after checking actual dates, consolidation scope, currency, and measurement basis: for example, an inflation-adjusted June YTD cannot be reduced by a March YTD until the latter is expressed in June purchasing power, and a nominal-to-IAS-29 transition cannot be repaired by a blanket multiplier.

Use actual period end dates for CPI and monthly FX lookup; KAP fiscal Q1 does not necessarily end in March, and the first FX trading date need not be the first calendar day. Require complete monthly CPI spans and exact adjacent periods for growth and TTM; preserve reported facts and return null for unsupported derivations.

EPS has independent currency/nominal-share units and historical weighted-average denominators. Never multiply EPS by a monetary statement multiplier, subtract YTD EPS, or use current company share metadata to reconstruct historical EPS.

Run database regressions only in disposable databases through `tests/conftest.py`; never point integration-test mutations directly at the user's financial database. Back up active publication pointers and derived financial datasets before a production repair, retain Bronze/Silver history, and rebuild only companies that already have published Gold data unless the user requests broader publication.

## Learnings

KAP repeats borrowing leaf labels under related-party and unrelated-party parents. Keep "other short-term borrowings" and "other current portion of long-term borrowings" at hierarchy level 3, beneath the level-2 counterparty branch; equal labels or equal amounts do not establish equal financial identities. Legacy paths can be reconstructed from ordered Bronze parent rows during Gold calculation without re-importing statements; never resolve conflicting facts by choosing the first row, summing them, or treating changing taxonomy row numbers as stable cross-report identities.

Is Yatirim `HGDG_KAPANIS` is an adjusted historical price; use `HG_KAPANIS` (`at_the_date_close_price` in Bronze payloads) for historical P/E against period-reported EPS. For example ALKA's 2022-12-30 adjusted close was 9.1004 while its original close was 37.04: substituting one for the other changes valuation materially. Use actual fiscal end dates and compatible nominal-share and purchasing-power bases, retain price/EPS provenance, and label quarter-end ratios retrospective because same-period earnings may be disclosed later.

KAP EPS values often live in `new-type-row` children, whose captions/numbers lack `gwt-Label`; repeated empty EPS headers are not observations. Map direct `taxonomy-context-value` cells to the enclosing table's date headers without dropping empty cells or counting caption/footnote TDs. HTML and PDF column order can differ (ASELS 2026 Q2: HTML current quarter is column 3, 186.65 raw kuruş, normalized to 1.8665 TRY); validate EPS units using explicit PDF disclosures and disclosed-profit/weighted-share reconciliation, never the statement monetary multiplier. Preserve source row/date/unit evidence and verified JSON inputs; quarantine source disagreements rather than choosing a convenient value.

For EPS normalized per 1 TRY nominal capital, the individual legal-share nominal value cancels: use attributable ordinary earnings divided by time-weighted outstanding nominal capital, with verified treasury holdings, class rights, and bonus/rights/split adjustments on a common basis. Historical Is Yatirim capital is a candidate input, not proof of outstanding capital or corporate-action timing; ignore inflation capital-adjustment reserves in this denominator. Explicitly disclosed EPS per 1 TRY nominal can establish its own unit without requiring an independently extracted weighted-share table; mixed-currency PDFs can have six date/currency columns with blank EPS cells (EREGL), and disclosed inputs can support calculated basic EPS even when only diluted EPS is labeled (KOTON). Unknown share-basis identifiers are an unresolved ingestion/reconciliation task, not evidence that compatible share bases cannot be established; estimates must remain distinguishable from reported or verified calculated EPS.

`calculate-eps` refreshes only EPS, coverage, and P/E atomically against existing financial dataset versions; retain replaced derived rows in `ops.eps_refresh_snapshots` and record the actual EPS refresh run in `calculation_details.eps_refresh_run_id`. EPS source-processing eligibility is bounded by the valuation run, since newly ingested EPS may postdate the underlying financial dataset run. Keep historical-issued-capital proxies in `gold.current_eps_coverage` with explicit per-field quality and assumptions, never in verified EPS/P/E; a short opening-capital assumption must not establish a verified share basis. Resolve missing EPS purchasing-power metadata from the matching current filing context before deriving TTM, and keep each EPS row's currency separate from adjacent basic/diluted rows.

An EPS reporting nominal unit can differ from the legal-share unit: ALCAR's EPS-note footnote declares a 1 TRY basis even though its capital note describes 0.01 TRY legal shares. Resolve the EPS note and attached footnotes before considering capital-note nominal values; the new independent reported-value reader requires an explicit EPS-local nominal basis. Blindly combining a `(TL)` EPS label with a global legal-share nominal creates a 100-fold error, even when both pieces of text are individually correct.
